inactive.exit_condition: A valid req bind operation binds one human-locked REQ.

planning.description: PM/Architect produces or revises the formal planning phases design, contracts and tasks. The phase cursor is authoritative; artifact inspection is reserved for explicit legacy reconciliation.
planning.entry_condition: The locked baseline is captured (TR-001) or specification rework is required (TR-004/013/023).
planning.exit_condition: At least one CONTRACTS-*.md has status=locked AND at least one TASK-*.md has status=complete (TR-002).

document_verification.description: Independent Document Verifiers inspect reviewed contracts and candidate tasks together.
document_verification.entry_condition: Planning output is complete and internally reviewed.
document_verification.exit_condition: Documents pass, require rework, or require a human REQ change.

building.description: Builders read back, activate and implement the atomically locked contract/task batch.
building.entry_condition: DOCUMENT_PASS locks exact contract and task versions.
building.exit_condition: Builder reports are complete or specification rework is required.

verification.description: Delivery Verifier, QA, and E2E Browser teams run a complete review round; findings are investigated before repair.
verification.entry_condition: Builder or repair output is ready for a full review round.
verification.exit_condition: A valid clean round passes, a finding enters BUG resolution, or the Loop pauses.

bug_resolution.description: Findings are investigated, accepted as canonical BUGs, repaired and rechecked by the original finding responsibility.
bug_resolution.entry_condition: A blocking Delivery Verifier, QA, or E2E Browser finding exists.
bug_resolution.exit_condition: Targeted re-verification passes and affected evidence is invalidated, or specification/REQ change is required.

acceptance.description: ACC is assembled from the locked baseline and one valid clean round.
acceptance.entry_condition: All required same-round evidence passes and no blocking BUG remains.
acceptance.exit_condition: ACC is complete or evidence requires another full review.

release_audit.description: Release architecture, migration, rollback and operational readiness are audited.
release_audit.exit_condition: Audit is approved or blocking findings pause the Loop.

paused.description: Automation is suspended with an exact state, phase and entity checkpoint.
paused.entry_condition: Human decision, REQ change, high-risk action, repair limit or runtime integrity requires a pause.
paused.exit_condition: Human action resumes the checkpoint, reinitializes a changed baseline, or aborts the Loop.

awaiting_human_release.description: Loop automation is complete and cannot perform squash merge or formal release.
awaiting_human_release.entry_condition: ACC and release architecture audit are approved.

aborted.description: A human terminated the Loop without release.

design.description: Design phase. The Architect completes the architecture package and any required UI design package for the bound REQ.
design.entry_condition: TR-001 binds a locked REQ, or a rework transition returns the Loop from DV / building / bug_resolution / paused.
design.exit_condition: GATE-PLANNING-DESIGN-COMPLETE is satisfied and PTR-PLAN-01 is committed.

contracts.description: Contracts phase. The Contractor publishes the locked BE/SYNC/FE contract set with complete REQ and architecture traceability.
contracts.exit_condition: GATE-PLANNING-CONTRACTS-COMPLETE is satisfied and PTR-PLAN-02 is committed.

tasks.description: Tasks phase. The Task Planner publishes a complete executable TASK batch and dependency DAG.
tasks.exit_condition: GATE-PLANNING-TASKS-COMPLETE is satisfied and TR-002 moves the Loop to document_verification.

transitions.description: Advance formal planning from design to contracts after the design quality gate passes.
Advance formal planning from contracts to tasks after the contract quality gate passes.

delivery.description: Run every required Delivery Verifier responsibility for the current round.
delivery.entry_condition: A complete team manifest and Builder/repair evidence exist.
delivery.exit_condition: All dimensions pass or findings leave the top-level state.

qa.description: Run every required QA responsibility for the same review round.
qa.exit_condition: All QA dimensions pass or findings leave the top-level state.

e2e_browser.description: Run real-browser E2E user flows for the same review round.
e2e_browser.entry_condition: Delivery Verifier and QA dimensions pass.
e2e_browser.exit_condition: All required E2E browser responsibilities pass or findings leave the top-level state.

clean_round_evaluation.description: Validate same-round completeness, evidence freshness and closed blocking BUGs.
clean_round_evaluation.entry_condition: Delivery, QA, and E2E Browser all report PASS for one round.
clean_round_evaluation.exit_condition: The round passes or review restarts at delivery.

clean_round_passed.description: One complete and current review round satisfies the acceptance gate.

transitions.description: QA cannot start until all required delivery dimensions pass.
Real-browser E2E follows complete QA evidence.
Clean-round evaluation follows complete real-browser E2E evidence.
Only one complete, current and blocker-free round passes.
Mixed, incomplete or stale evidence restarts the full review.

investigation.description: Reproduce findings and determine root cause.
investigation.exit_condition: Root cause and evidence are sufficient to draft canonical BUGs.

bug_report_review.description: The orchestrator deduplicates and accepts canonical BUG reports.
bug_report_review.entry_condition: BUG drafts contain reproduction, root cause and Closing Contract.
bug_report_review.exit_condition: Every blocking finding has an explicit disposition. An insufficient BUG report returns to investigation (PTR-BUG-03); an accepted canonical BUG enters repair_readback (PTR-BUG-02); a final rejected finding with no product or specification change, or a duplicate whose canonical target needs no remaining repair, may use TR-022 only when no accepted BUG remains; a duplicate of an open canonical BUG follows that BUG's repair path; spec rework uses TR-023 and REQ change uses TR-024.

repair_readback.description: Repair Builders read BUG plus the original specification chain and submit structured understanding.
repair_readback.exit_condition: Understanding and phase-two activation are approved.

fixing.description: Activated repair Builders implement within approved BUG/task scope.
fixing.exit_condition: Fix reports, changed paths and validation evidence exist.

targeted_reverification.description: The original finding responsibility checks each BUG Closing Contract.
targeted_reverification.entry_condition: Repair evidence exists and affected PASS evidence is invalidated.
targeted_reverification.exit_condition: Targeted checks pass or return to investigation.

ready_for_full_review.description: A terminal handoff checkpoint inside S9: targeted checks pass and no further S9 work may start; the only successor is TR-012 into a complete Delivery + QA + E2E Browser round.
ready_for_full_review.entry_condition: All repaired BUGs pass targeted re-verification.
ready_for_full_review.exit_condition: TR-012 returns the top-level Loop to verification.delivery.

transitions.description: A finding cannot become repair work before root-cause evidence exists.
The orchestrator approves canonical BUGs and duplicate mappings.
Insufficient BUG reports return to investigation.
Repair execution uses the same two-phase activation gate.
Every repair invalidates affected historical PASS evidence before recheck.
A targeted pass never substitutes for the full review round; it records the S9-to-S7 handoff checkpoint.
Failed repair verification restarts root-cause investigation.
Start exactly one Loop for the named locked REQ.
Planning completes when at least one CONTRACTS-*.md is locked AND at least one TASK-*.md is complete. Direct file+status check via the planning_complete guard.
Lock only the exact contract and task versions jointly verified.
Non-REQ document findings return to planning.design for reworking the failing artifacts.
REQ changes always return control to the human.
Start a complete review round after all activated Builders report.
Non-REQ execution conflicts return through planning and document verification.
Any blocking Delivery, QA, or E2E Browser finding means the REQ batch is incomplete and must enter S8 investigation before repair.
Acceptance requires one complete, current and blocker-free review round.
A required REQ change pauses automation.
Security, compliance or equivalent blockers require human intervention.
Only the ready_for_full_review handoff checkpoint may enter a complete Delivery + QA + E2E Browser round; targeted re-verification never substitutes for that round.
Repair-driven specification changes return through planning and document verification.
Repair work cannot modify the locked REQ.
Release audit starts only from current ACC and clean-round evidence.
Acceptance discrepancies restart the complete review.
Approved or approved-with-risk audit reaches the human release boundary.
A blocked release audit pauses the Loop.
Resume the exact validated state, phase and entity checkpoint.
A changed locked REQ starts a new planning generation.
Only a human may permanently abort the Loop.

When the completed S8 disposition batch contains no accepted BUG, every finding is finally rejected without product/specification change or duplicate-linked to a canonical BUG with no remaining repair, the Loop returns to verification for a fresh complete round. An insufficient BUG report remains in investigation; spec and REQ changes use TR-023 and TR-024.
Finding-level specification rework (S8) routes back to planning.design for a new TR-002 cycle; complements TR-013 which handles repair-level spec change.
A finding that requires modifying the locked REQ cannot proceed autonomously; the Loop pauses for human amendment. Complements TR-014 which handles repair-level REQ change.

global_transitions.description: A user may pause from any active state.
Any required locked REQ change pauses automation.
Production-data, security, compliance or irreversible actions require human approval.
Configured repair limits never silently close a BUG.

forbidden_events.reason: Loop automation cannot change the human-controlled REQ baseline.
Task and Agent Definition scope is mandatory.
Only jointly verified contract and task versions may lock.
Acceptance requires one valid complete review round.
Release audit requires complete ACC evidence.
Squash merge to master/main is human-controlled.
Formal release is outside Loop automation.

invariants.statement: At most one active Loop binds exactly one locked REQ version.
REQ binding authorizes one human-locked REQ without a separate /goal; Claude /loop only schedules Wake-up prompts.
Loop automation never modifies or locks a REQ.
UI-impacting planning cannot reach contracts without the UI Design Package Gate.
Only jointly verified exact contract and task versions lock for execution.
Agent phase one is read-only and phase two activation is explicit.
Delivery, QA, and E2E Browser work uses complete single-responsibility team manifests.
Every blocking finding maps to an accepted canonical BUG before repair.
Repair reads BUG plus the original specification chain.
Original finding responsibilities reverify repairs before a complete review restarts.
Repair invalidates affected evidence and targeted checks never replace the complete review.
A clean round uses current evidence from one complete round and has no blocking BUG.
ACC and release audit require a valid clean round.
Squash merge and formal release require external human approval.
Runtime recovery restores state, phase and entity checkpoints without chat history.
